In the One Mile Medley Relay Main ran the quarter—an unusual racing distance for him, but held on grimly in third place to hand over to McKeown who maintained his place for the first furlong.
McKeown was second in the Youths' 880 yards, won in 2 mins. 6.2 secs. Clay and Frost qualified for the final of the sprint but were unplaced.
